name: crossproof
description: CrossProof: Decentralized Cross-Chain Transaction Verification Protocol

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@crossproof/shared && npm run build --workspace=@crossproof/proof && npm run build --workspace=@crossproof/api && npm run build --workspace=@crossproof/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@crossproof/shared && npm run build --workspace=@crossproof/proof && npm run build --workspace=@crossproof/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@crossproof/shared && npm run build --workspace=@crossproof/web
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:packages
